criteria.name: Info and relationships
criteria.evidence: axe label (critical) on 13 of 14 stories, WithLabel included: Label gets htmlFor={id} and the input id={id}, so without an id prop the label is not tied to the field and the field has no name
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): generate an id (useId) when none is passed, so label and field always connect.

criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: axe color-contrast passes on all 14 stories: #333333 on white

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: screenshots and scroll width at 1280, 390 and 320: no horizontal scroll

criteria.name: Non-text contrast
criteria.evidence: computed: border 1px #767676 on white 4.54:1; focus border 2px #EF0071 4.27:1

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play): Tab focuses the field, typing reaches onChange

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: keyboard run: border goes from 1px #767676 to 2px #EF0071 on Tab

criteria.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
criteria.evidence: screenshots: nothing in the component covers the focused field

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Error identification
criteria.evidence: Error story: the message renders under the field
criteria.note: Whether an error message tells people how to fix the entry is for a person to judge.

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: whether a form asks for the same data twice is decided by the page

criteria.name: Accessible authentication (minimum)
criteria.evidence: source: paste is never blocked (onMultilinePaste reads the clipboard and passes it on) and autocomplete reaches the input
criteria.note: Password and email fields can be filled by a password manager.

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.evidence: same root as 1.3.1: Label gets htmlFor={id} and the input id={id}, so without an id prop the label is not tied to the field and the field has no name
criteria.note: Fixed by the same heal as 1.3.1.
